metadata.schedule_summary: Both chemotherapy medicines are planned on Day 1 of a 21-day cycle. For pleural mesothelioma, the source describes up to 4–6 cycles. For advanced non-squamous NSCLC, it describes 4–6 combination cycles followed, when appropriate, by a separate pemetrexed maintenance plan (NCCP00222). The selected preoperative nivolumab combination uses three cycles and a separate immunotherapy plan (NCCP00849). Your team confirms which course applies and may stop or change it earlier.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: The treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist or other appropriately authorised specialist named in the current NCCP source.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Use the most restrictive applicable component rule and confirm all dose changes against the current official NCCP PDF.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding derived from NCCP 00318 Version 6. It does not replace the current official regimen, prescribing review, pharmacy verification or independent clinical judgement.
clinical_governance.organ_function_rule_status: Source reconciled in SACTCheck v0.59.0; independent Consultant and oncology-pharmacy validation pending.

indications.description: Chemotherapy-naïve unresectable malignant pleural mesothelioma; off-label in Ireland.
First-line locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC, with non-squamous histology selection; off-label in Ireland.
With nivolumab for neoadjuvant resectable NSCLC at high recurrence risk, adult PD-L1 ≥1%; three cycles; assess NCCP00849 separately.

rules.explanation: Pemetrexed is not recommended when verified creatinine clearance is below 45 mL/min.

action.recommendation: Pemetrexed is not recommended during haemodialysis; specialist review is required.

rules.explanation: Pemetrexed is not recommended during haemodialysis; specialist review is required.

rules.explanation: Do not administer carboplatin at GFR ≤20 mL/min.

rules.explanation: GFR >20 to ≤30 mL/min: carboplatin only with extreme caution and specialist review; the ≤20 do-not-administer row takes precedence at 20.

action.recommendation: Renal impairment increases carboplatin myelosuppression risk. Verify the renal measure and dosing; this finding does not override any exclusion or hold.

rules.explanation: Renal impairment increases carboplatin myelosuppression risk. Verify the renal measure and dosing; this finding does not override any exclusion or hold.

action.recommendation: Cockcroft–Gault/Wright dosing requires serum creatinine obtained within 48 hours of administration. Refresh the measurement before determining the dose.

rules.explanation: Cockcroft–Gault/Wright dosing requires serum creatinine obtained within 48 hours of administration. Refresh the measurement before determining the dose.

action.recommendation: Creatinine exceeds 110% of the isotope-GFR baseline: consider remeasuring GFR or re-estimating by Cockcroft–Gault/Wright. Do not assume the previous dose remains valid.

rules.explanation: Creatinine exceeds 110% of the isotope-GFR baseline: consider remeasuring GFR or re-estimating by Cockcroft–Gault/Wright. Do not assume the previous dose remains valid.

action.recommendation: Carboplatin GFR entry does not confirm a pemetrexed CrCl assessment. Supply verified pemetrexed CrCl or its source band; absent data are not normal.

rules.explanation: Carboplatin GFR entry does not confirm a pemetrexed CrCl assessment. Supply verified pemetrexed CrCl or its source band; absent data are not normal.

action.recommendation: Pemetrexed is not recommended in severe hepatic impairment because of liver-dysfunction risk. Mild/moderate hepatic impairment needs no expected reduction; the platinum has no hepatic adjustment in this table.

rules.explanation: Pemetrexed is not recommended in severe hepatic impairment because of liver-dysfunction risk. Mild/moderate hepatic impairment needs no expected reduction; the platinum has no hepatic adjustment in this table.

action.recommendation: Withhold until at or below the pre-therapy baseline; then both drugs at 75% of their previous doses. A current-dose history and consultant decision are required.

rules.explanation: Withhold until at or below the pre-therapy baseline; then both drugs at 75% of their previous doses. A current-dose history and consultant decision are required.

action.recommendation: Withhold until at or below the pre-therapy baseline; then pemetrexed at 50% and carboplatin at 100% of their previous doses. Confirm current-dose history.

rules.explanation: Withhold until at or below the pre-therapy baseline; then pemetrexed at 50% and carboplatin at 100% of their previous doses. Confirm current-dose history.

action.recommendation: Withhold until at or below pre-therapy baseline. Establish recurrence: any recurrence requires discontinuation; the first-event grade 2 restart table differs.

rules.explanation: Withhold until at or below pre-therapy baseline. Establish recurrence: any recurrence requires discontinuation; the first-event grade 2 restart table differs.

action.recommendation: Withhold until at or below pre-therapy baseline; then pemetrexed 100% and reduce carboplatin by 50%. Confirm previous doses with consultant/pharmacy.

rules.explanation: Withhold until at or below pre-therapy baseline; then pemetrexed 100% and reduce carboplatin by 50%. Confirm previous doses with consultant/pharmacy.

action.recommendation: Discontinue for grade ≥3 neurotoxicity or any recurrence of neurotoxicity.

rules.explanation: Discontinue for grade ≥3 neurotoxicity or any recurrence of neurotoxicity.

action.recommendation: Withhold other grade ≥3 toxicity until at or below pre-therapy baseline. Confirm prior reductions before choosing restart or discontinuation review.

rules.explanation: Withhold other grade ≥3 toxicity until at or below pre-therapy baseline. Confirm prior reductions before choosing restart or discontinuation review.

action.recommendation: Withhold until at or below pre-therapy baseline, then both drugs at 75% of previous doses after consultant review.

rules.explanation: Withhold until at or below pre-therapy baseline, then both drugs at 75% of previous doses after consultant review.

action.recommendation: Grade ≥3 toxicity after two dose reductions: consider discontinuing both drugs; discuss with consultant. This is a decision, not an automatic permanent stop.

rules.explanation: Grade ≥3 toxicity after two dose reductions: consider discontinuing both drugs; discuss with consultant. This is a decision, not an automatic permanent stop.

action.recommendation: Clinician decision: consider discontinuing whichever drug caused the grade ≥3 allergy. Identify the culprit and manage the acute reaction; do not infer that both drugs must permanently stop.

rules.explanation: Clinician decision: consider discontinuing whichever drug caused the grade ≥3 allergy. Identify the culprit and manage the acute reaction; do not infer that both drugs must permanently stop.

action.recommendation: Verify required folic acid and B12 before pemetrexed: at least five folate doses in the preceding seven days; B12 in the preceding week. Resolve missing supplementation with the prescriber.

rules.explanation: Verify required folic acid and B12 before pemetrexed: at least five folate doses in the preceding seven days; B12 in the preceding week. Resolve missing supplementation with the prescriber.

action.recommendation: Confirm pemetrexed rash prophylaxis equivalent to dexamethasone 4 mg twice daily on the day before, day of and day after treatment. Reconcile with the antiemetic steroid into one prescription.

rules.explanation: Confirm pemetrexed rash prophylaxis equivalent to dexamethasone 4 mg twice daily on the day before, day of and day after treatment. Reconcile with the antiemetic steroid into one prescription.

action.recommendation: Pemetrexed NSCLC use requires non-squamous histology selection. Review the treatment plan; the mesothelioma indication is separate.

rules.explanation: Pemetrexed NSCLC use requires non-squamous histology selection. Review the treatment plan; the mesothelioma indication is separate.

action.recommendation: NCCP00849 nivolumab eligibility, immune toxicity, monitoring and consent must be assessed separately. This is the chemotherapy component assessment.

rules.explanation: NCCP00849 nivolumab eligibility, immune toxicity, monitoring and consent must be assessed separately. This is the chemotherapy component assessment.

action.recommendation: The selected neoadjuvant nivolumab combination is three cycles only. Reconcile the plan before any additional combination cycle.

rules.explanation: The selected neoadjuvant nivolumab combination is three cycles only. Reconcile the plan before any additional combination cycle.

action.recommendation: The source combination course is at most 4–6 cycles for mesothelioma or 4–6 for advanced NSCLC. Review any further platinum combination cycle; pemetrexed maintenance is a separate NCCP00222 plan.

rules.explanation: The source combination course is at most 4–6 cycles for mesothelioma or 4–6 for advanced NSCLC. Review any further platinum combination cycle; pemetrexed maintenance is a separate NCCP00222 plan.

eligibility: Indication as listed in the current official NCCP regimen
Performance status, histology, stage and biomarker eligibility appropriate to the selected indication
Organ function appropriate for the selected regimen
exclusions: Known hypersensitivity to a regimen component
Pregnancy or breastfeeding where prohibited by the current source
Regimen-specific exclusions encoded in the interactive assessment
monitoring: Baseline FBC, renal and liver profile; audiology if clinically indicated. Measured isotope GFR preferred or validated GFR/clearance estimation.
Repeat FBC, renal and liver profile before each cycle. Review infection, bleeding, gastrointestinal toxicity, neuropathy, hearing and medicines.
Disease assessment and additional tests follow the consultant treatment plan; no universal scan interval is specified.
dose_modifications: Source count thresholds use current pretreatment counts; nadir wording was removed in the October 2025 source update.
All dose modifications require consultant discussion. Previous-dose adverse-event percentages are not automatically applied to the original protocol doses.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: Carboplatin AUC5 high risk; use dedicated AUC≥4 phase support plan without routine olanzapine.
supportive_care.supportive_medications_label: NCCP NCIS Medical Oncology V8: dedicated carboplatin AUC ≥4

treatment_phases.label: Day 1 chemotherapy in a 21-day cycle
notes: Pemetrexed then carboplatin. Calvert formula uses the verified GFR, capped at 125 mL/min; measured GFR preferred.

Mesothelioma: maximum 4–6 cycles; advanced NSCLC: 4–6 cycles then separately assessed pemetrexed maintenance NCCP00222 if appropriate; neoadjuvant nivolumab context: three cycles with separate NCCP00849 plan.
